details: The package runs a preinstall hook that downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime and executes a 727KB obfuscated payload (math_init.js) during installation. The payload is encoded with a custom string-obfuscation scheme to hide its behaviour. The package also depends on @or-sdk/base and @or-sdk/data-hub-svc, which are known-malicious packages, indicating the install-time payload is part of a broader supply-chain compromise. Installing this package executes the obfuscated payload on the victim's machine at install time.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
